html:
Every tag of the finished bottle line, from the program the page loads with File → Load Reference Solution: Complete Bottle Line (15 steps). Alias tags first, then the program’s own tags.

Plain tags

TagTypeStyleDescription
Haz_ReqBOOLHazard tape requested for the box at LS13 (latched while the applicator cycles)
Haz_FaultBOOLHazard-tape dispenser fault, latched until Enter
Cap_Fill_TTIMERCap feeder run-on after CapLow clears
Large_Bottle_CountDINTLogixPro O:4/0 · Large bottle count, shown on the LARGE display
Small_Bottle_CountDINTLogixPro O:4/1 · Small bottle count, shown on the SMALL display
Scrap_Bottle_CountDINTLogixPro O:4/2 · Scrap bottle count, shown on the SCRAP display
Scrap_Box_CountDINTLogixPro O:4/3 · Scrap box count, shown on the BOXES display
Line_RunBOOLSeal-in run bit (LogixPro B3:0/0)
Conv_IndexBOOLLatched while the belt steps one pitch
A_ONSBOOLOne-shot storage for the encoder edge
DwellTIMERBelt stopped: sensors read, feeder drops a bottle
RejectDINT[2]BinaryBad bottle (the camera found no cap, no label or a short fill), one bit per stop from the stop past the camera. During the dwell: scrap gate 0, divert gate 7; after the shift one bit higher
Reject_CtlCONTROLBSL control for Reject
Insp_ReqBOOLAn inspection is under way: triggered, no result yet (holds the belt)
Insp_DoneBOOLThis stop's bottle has been inspected
Insp_CodeDINTThe camera's result code for this stop's bottle: 0 pass; bit 0 no cap, bit 1 no label, bit 2 short fill
Cam_BadBOOLThe verdict for the bottle at the camera, shifted into Reject at the next stop
Shift_ONSBOOLOne-shot storage: clear the verdict after the shift has taken it
CAM_ONSBOOLOne-shot storage for the camera alarm
Insp_CountDINTBottles inspected
Insp_Reject_CountDINTBottles the camera rejected
IC_ONSBOOLOne-shot storage for the inspected count
RC_ONSBOOLOne-shot storage for the rejected count
ExistDINT[2]BinaryBottle present, one bit per stop (LogixPro B3:10). During the dwell: filler 6, capper 9, scrap gate 13, divert gate 20; after the shift (Dwell.DN) one bit higher
LargeDINT[2]BinaryLarge bottle (LogixPro B3:20). During the dwell: filler 5, capper 8, scrap gate 12, divert gate 19; after the shift one bit higher
BrokenDINT[2]BinaryBroken bottle (LogixPro B3:30). During the dwell: filler 4, capper 7, scrap gate 11, divert gate 18; after the shift one bit higher
Exist_CtlCONTROLLogixPro R6:1
Large_CtlCONTROLLogixPro R6:2
Broken_CtlCONTROLLogixPro R6:3
Fill_ReqBOOLA bottle stands under the filler and still needs its charge
Fill_DoneBOOLLatched when the charge is in; cleared when the belt steps
Cap_ReqBOOLA bottle stands under the cap ram and has not been capped
Cap_DoneBOOLLatched when the ram has been down; cleared when the belt steps
Label_ReqBOOLLatched while the labeler is asked to apply; cleared at PadIn
Label_AppliedBOOLLatched when the label is pressed on; cleared when the belt steps
Label_FaultBOOLLatched on the labeler Error input (end of roll or a missed label); Enter clears it
Alarm_WordDINTBinaryLatched alarms, one bit each: 0 main conveyor overload, 1 divert conveyor overload, 2 end-of-line check failed (a jam, a lost bottle, tracking out of step), 3 LS1 dark too long (dirty lens or feeder empty), 4 labeler fault, 5 reservoir inlet open but level not rising, 6 case lane drive tripped, 7 packer infeed full
Alarm_UnackBOOLNew alarm, not yet acknowledged (Reset)
Main_OL_TTIMERMain conveyor overload timer (no running feedback)
Cam_Off_TTIMERThe camera has been off line for 2 s with the line running
Div_OL_TTIMERDivert conveyor overload timer (no running feedback)
EOL_MissingBOOLLS11 dark when the registers said a large, whole bottle was there
EOL_ExtraBOOLLS11 saw a bottle the registers did not expect
EOL_InhibitBOOLTracking cleared by Reset: the end-of-line check waits until the first bottle tracked since then reaches LS11
EOL_ONSBOOL
LS1_Dark_TTIMERLS1 dark too long timer
Inlet_TTIMERInlet not filling timer
Flash_TTIMERFault lamp flasher
OL_ONSBOOL
DOL_ONSBOOL
BLK_ONSBOOL
Reg_ClearBOOL
DRK_ONSBOOL
LBL_ONSBOOL
INL_ONSBOOL
RST_ONSBOOL
VFD_ONSBOOL
INF_ONSBOOL
Case_HzREALCase lane speed the program wants, in Hz
Case_Hz_ActualREALCase lane drive output frequency read back, in Hz
Case_CountDINTCases packed, shown on the CASES display
Case_CreepBOOLLatched from the slow-down eye until an empty case stands under the head
Drop_ONSBOOL
Case_ONSBOOL
Scrap_ONSBOOL
Divert_ONSBOOL
Small_ONSBOOL
Large_ONSBOOL
Box_ONSBOOL
Enter_ONSBOOL
Batch_DoneBOOLThe large-bottle count has reached the thumbwheel preset
Mix_StartBOOLSTART on Tank_HMI (pulsed by the touch screen)
Mix_StopBOOLSTOP on Tank_HMI (pulsed by the touch screen)
Mix_RunBOOLThe mix kitchen is running (its own seal-in)
Mix_Auto_StartBOOLOne scan when the line starts: starts the kitchen too
Mix_Line_ONSBOOL

Dose_PreDINTWater dose for this batch, in flowmeter pulses
Mix_MsDINTMixing time in ms (Mix_Time × 1000)
Dose_ACOUNTERWater dose: flowmeter A pulses
Mix_TimerTIMERMixing time at temperature
Mix_Empty_TTIMERLO uncovered this long: the tank is empty

Mix_Target_TREALBatch temperature, °F: the setpoint on Tank_HMI (TEMP page)
Mix_CarbBOOLThe recipe takes CO2 (1 for soda; set by the RECIPE page on Tank_HMI). The carbonator's CO2 valve only works while it is 1: juice, water and milk go through still
Mix_Lo_TREALBottom of the heater band: 2 °F under Mix_Target_T
Mix_RatioREALWater share of the batch, %: A SHARE on the RECIPE page
Mix_TimeDINTMixing time, s: MIX TIME on the RECIPE page
Case_Large_CountDINTCases of large bottles packed (CASES LARGE on Pack_HMI)
Case_Small_CountDINTCases of small bottles packed (CASES SMALL on Pack_HMI)
Pack_StartBOOLSTART on Pack_HMI (pulsed by the touch screen)
Pack_StopBOOLSTOP on Pack_HMI (pulsed by the touch screen)
Pack_RunBOOLThe packer is running (its own seal-in)
Pack_Auto_StartBOOLOne scan when the line starts: starts the packer too
